frames.coverage_assessment: Purple covers a broken/low strip below and left of the SUV's underside. It overlaps the weak dark region nearest the left/central wheels but is disconnected and does not form a complete contact boundary. frames.likely_omissions: The area beneath the vehicle's central and right underside/right rear wheel (about x=317..350) is mostly unmarked, despite being the natural continuation to inspect for contact shading. No clear broad projected shadow extending away from the tires is covered.
frames.road_or_marking_false_positive: The lower strip reaches exposed roadway below-left of the SUV, so some included pixels may be normal pavement. It does not visibly run onto the bright transverse line lower in the image or the long road-texture seams. The separate sedan at far right is not included, which is appropriate for the specified SUV target.

frames.coverage_assessment: The purple candidate is fragmented and mainly left of/just under the SUV's left-to-central lower edge. It captures only a small part of the faint dark contact zone visible in the RGB; the separately visible lower edge under the rest of the SUV is not outlined as one coherent region.
frames.likely_omissions: The candidate leaves the central-to-right tire/underbody area (roughly x=300..350) unmarked and does not capture a larger projected-shadow envelope. Whether these omitted pixels are actual shadow cannot be decided from this RGB alone.

The small segment at y=224 is just beyond the SUV's visible underside and may include exposed roadway; treat as a possible edge overreach, not a certain false positive. The right-hand sedan's own dark contact region remains separate.

overall_assessment: Across all three frames, the purple proposal behaves like a sparse lower-left/underbody candidate rather than a complete vehicle-shadow region. It partially covers faint darkening close to the SUV's wheels/underside, misses the central/right underside extent and does not establish a separate cast-shadow perimeter. The inspected purple pixels do not clearly spill onto the bright road markings or long pavement seams; the exposed road immediately left/below the SUV remains an ambiguous edge where overreach is possible. These are AI model observations for candidate validation, not a human verdict or ground-truth segmentation.
